name: Criminology Honours
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum of 120 units, including a minimum of 60 upper division units, as specified below with CGPAs in accordance with general and Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences graduation requirements including a minimum 3.00 CGPA.

sections.note:
This structured program for outstanding undergraduate students complements the criminology major program and consists of two terms of advanced course work and supervised research.
Honours students write and defend a short thesis.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students with a minimum 2.25 CGPA are eligible to enroll in upper division criminology courses upon successful completion of 45 units and criminology program declaration.

grades.label: Program Declaration and Continuation
grades.text: Students normally apply for the criminology honours program in the Spring term (February) and typically complete 104 total units with a minimum 3.00 CGPA prior to the start of the honours program in the Fall term (September).

grades.label: Program Declaration and Continuation
grades.text: To continue in the honours program, students must maintain a 3.00 CGPA.

grades.label: Program Declaration and Continuation
grades.text: Students whose CGPA falls below 3.00 cannot enroll in CRIM 499 and, therefore, cannot complete the program.

grades.label: Program Declaration and Continuation
grades.text: Students whose CGPA falls below 2.25 cannot enroll in any upper division CRIM courses.
